why: XPP one-time init (cmp [0x379C6C],0 / jne; sets it to 1, sets up the ports). Reached through an indirect call at boot; no pass found it, so the call failed to resolve.

CRT callback dispatcher (cmp [esp+4],0; calls [0x3F4884] or [0x3F4888]; ret 4). The function before it ends in a call to the thread-exit routine at 0x2A98D4, which never returns, and the disassembler ran on into this one. Called through a pointer thousands of times from the intro movies on.
A lone `ret` at the tail of sub_0030C056 in D3DX: MSVC folds empty functions onto a ret byte, and a vtable slot points here. Reached once, just after the legal screen.

CRT _trandisp2 special-case handler (fstp st0; fstp st0; fldz; ret): two-argument math (pow, atan2...) jumps here through the table at 0x3F48E0 for a zero result. Missed, so the case was skipped with the x87 stack left wrong; hit repeatedly in the training level.
Another _trandisp2 handler, four slots of the same table (0x3F48E4/EC/F4/FC). Never found as a function; seeded with its sibling.
